requirement.description: The Tags class implementation has two main issues: 1) incorrect ordering of tags when mixing regular tags and conditional expressions (If), and 2) failure to properly validate and raise TypeError for invalid tag inputs.

contract.description: The Tags class constructor should maintain the order of tags as provided by the user, regardless of whether they are regular tags or conditional expressions (like If). Additionally, when invalid inputs are provided (like plain strings or non-dict objects), the constructor should raise a TypeError with appropriate error messages.

inputs.input: Accepts keyword arguments for tag key-value pairs
Accepts positional arguments that can be dicts, AWSHelperFn objects, or other Tags instances
Should properly validate inputs and raise TypeError for invalid types

outputs.output: Tags object with properly ordered tags in the order they were provided
Should raise TypeError when invalid inputs are passed (e.g., string, integer, etc.)
